change.before: "the standalone User Operator did not handle a missing Cluster CA cert Secret when TLS is not needed"
change.after: "the standalone User Operator handles a missing Cluster CA cert Secret when TLS is not needed"

consequence.statement: An affected standalone User Operator deployment upgraded to 0.46.0 no longer hits an unhandled missing Cluster CA cert Secret, because the operator now handles that case when TLS is not needed.

assertion.statement: In Strimzi 0.46.0, the standalone User Operator was updated to handle the Cluster CA cert Secret being missing when TLS is not needed, changing how it behaves in such deployments.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Exposure cannot be expressed from static inputs: it depends on whether the User Operator runs standalone with TLS not needed and the Cluster CA cert Secret is absent at runtime; no chart value or manifest predicate carries that state.
